scope: First real binary context measurement, all nine findings retained visibly and unresolved. This is only an expected-regression baseline, not a policy fix, suppression, successful runtime test or release authorization. Original P0 CIL compilation still fails; the measured candidate has not been applied to images.

measurement.previous_baseline_status: The previous one-context baseline was a static-source prediction, not an executed binary-context measurement. This measured baseline records the eight additional findings, without declaring them repaired.

u:r:dsms_app:s0.reason: Samsung vendor seapp rules request this legacy process type. The type exists in vendor_plat_pub_versioned.cil but the exact candidate binary rejects its u:r process context. Source lacks direct role-r authorization; binary role/domain traits are reported separately. This remains an unresolved conditional application-domain incompatibility, not a proven default boot failure.
